questions.stem: What is the thin wire inside the glass bulb of an incandescent lamp called?
questions.solution: The thin wire inside the glass bulb of an incandescent lamp is called the filament because it is the component that heats up and emits light when electricity passes through it. A wick is a material used in candles to draw up fuel, a wire is a general term for a conductor, and a cable is a group of wires bundled together, none of which specifically describe the light-emitting part of the lamp.

hi.stem: एक अंगूठी बल्ब के कांच के बल्ब के भीतर बालू तार क्या कहलाता है?

questions.stem: Which part of the incandescent lamp glows when the torch is switched on?
questions.solution: The filament is the thin wire inside the glass bulb that glows when the torch is switched on. The thick wire and metal tip are part of the lamp's structure but do not glow. The insulator is used to hold the filament in place and does not glow.

hi.solution: फिलामेंट बल्ब के अंदर का पतला तार होता है जो टॉर्च चालू करने पर चमकता है। मोटे तार और धातु के टिप बल्ब के संरचना के हिस्से होते हैं लेकिन चमकते नहीं हैं। आइसोलेटर फिलामेंट को स्थिर रखने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है और यह चमकता नहीं है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English question and solution, with appropriate technical terms used in a Hindi-medium context.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an insulator of electricity?
questions.solution: Rubber is an insulator of electricity because it does not allow electric current to pass through it easily. Copper, silver, and gold are metals, which are excellent conductors of electricity. Insulators like rubber are used to prevent the flow of electricity and protect against electric shocks.

questions.stem: What happens when the longer wire of an LED is connected to the negative terminal of a battery?
questions.solution: The LED does not glow because current can only pass through it in one direction. The longer wire of the LED is the positive terminal, so connecting it to the negative terminal of the battery prevents current flow. A pupil might think the LED will glow regardless of connections, but it only works when the polarity is correct.

questions.stem: In a torch, how are the cells arranged to provide energy to the circuit?
questions.solution: In a torch, the cells are arranged in series so that the positive terminal of one cell connects to the negative terminal of the next, creating a continuous path for electric current. This setup increases the total voltage available to the circuit. Arranging them in parallel or randomly would not provide sufficient voltage, and a circular pattern is not a standard electrical configuration.

hi.stem: टॉर्च में, सेल कैसे व्यवस्थित किए जाते हैं ताकि सर्किट को ऊर्जा प्रदान की जा सके?
hi.solution: टॉर्च में, सेल श्रेणी में व्यवस्थित किए जाते हैं ताकि एक सेल के धनात्मक टर्मिनल को अगले सेल के ऋणात्मक टर्मिनल से जोड़ा जा सके, जिससे विद्युत धारा के लिए एक निरंतर मार्ग बनता है। इस व्यवस्था से सर्किट के लिए कुल वोल्टेज बढ़ जाता है। समांतर या यादृच्छिक रूप से व्यवस्थित करने से पर्याप्त वोल्टेज प्राप्त नहीं होता है और एक वृत्ताकार पैटर्न मानक विद्युत व्यवस्था नहीं है।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate, maintains original meaning, and uses standard Hindi technical terms.

mr.stem: टॉर्चमध्ये, संपूर्ण परिपथाला ऊर्जा पुरविण्यासाठी सेल कशा व्यवस्थित केले जातात?

questions.stem: What happens to the current in an incandescent lamp when the circuit is complete?

questions.stem: Based on the circuit diagram in Fig. 3.14, which component allows the circuit to be opened or closed?
questions.solution: The switch allows the circuit to be opened or closed because it physically breaks or completes the electrical path. An electric cell provides power, an electric lamp emits light, and a wire simply conducts electricity without controlling the flow. questions.stem: If a torch uses three cells connected in series, what will happen to the lamp if one of the cells is removed?
questions.solution: When cells are connected in series, removing one cell breaks the continuous path needed for electric current to flow, so the lamp will not glow. This is because the circuit is no longer complete, preventing the flow of electricity. The other options are incorrect because they suggest changes in brightness or flickering, which would not occur if the circuit is completely broken.

hi.stem: यदि एक टॉर्च में तीन सेल श्रेणी में जुड़े हुए हैं, तो यदि एक सेल को हटा दिया जाए तो लैंप पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ेगा?
hi.solution: जब सेल श्रेणी में जुड़े होते हैं, तो एक सेल को हटाने से विद्युत धारा के प्रवाह के लिए आवश्यक लगातार पथ टूट जाता है, इसलिए लैंप नहीं जलेगा। ऐसा इसलिए है क्योंकि परिपथ अब पूरा नहीं है, जिससे विद्युत के प्रवाह को रोक दिया जाता है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे चमक में परिवर्तन या झिलमिलाहट के बारे में कहते हैं, जो परिपथ पूरी तरह से टूट जाने पर नहीं हो सकता।

questions.stem: In a circuit with a battery and a lamp, if the lamp does not glow, which of the following is the most likely cause?
choices: The battery is not connected properly
The wires are made of copper
questions.solution: If the battery is not connected properly, the circuit will not be complete, preventing current from flowing and causing the lamp not to glow. A LED can still glow if properly connected, and copper wires are good conductors that do not hinder current flow. A complete circuit is required for the lamp to function, so an improper battery connection is the most likely issue.

hi.stem: एक सर्किट में बैटरी और एक लैंप है, यदि लैंप नहीं जलता है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सबसे संभावित कारण है?
